31700-I.s: The bill formally establishes the 2009 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Household of the Queen (Huis der Koningin), fixing the appropriation of EUR 6,960 thousand for the annual allowance to members of the Royal House. It also sets the entry-into-force rules and the currency unit of the budget, and the explanatory memorandum describes the calculation of the allowance and related ministry costs without creating new executive powers.
q: Article 1 The budget statement of the Household of the Queen (I) for the year 2009 attached to this act is established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Huis der Koningin (I) voor het jaar 2009 wordt vastgesteld.

31700-XVIII.s: The bill formally sets the 2009 budget (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration and for the Rijksgebouwendienst, and fixes amounts in thousands of euros. It also allows the budget explanation to present the required per-policy-article information in one place rather than per article, as part of a government experiment in improving political accountability.
31700-XVIII.j: The memorandum justifies the article 4 deviation from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as needed for a government experiment to improve political accountability, not as an expansion of executive power.
q: For the purposes of the experiment, it is necessary to deviate for those years from several provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the departmental budget and the departmental annual report.

Ten behoeve van het experiment is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van de departementale begroting en het departementale jaarverslag.

31924-A.s: The bill approves a supplementary amendment (slotwet) to the 2008 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund, adjusting expenditure, commitments and revenue across infrastructure categories. It is a technical budget adjustment with no new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
31924-A.j: The memorandum explains the budget changes as technical implementation adjustments, bookkeeping changes and corrections from control findings, not as a grant of new powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes, or changes arising from control findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

32123-I.s: The bill sets the 2010 budget statement for the Crown (begroting de Koning) at EUR 39.6 million and amends the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for 2010 so that the Crown's budget covers the allowances to royal family members plus expenditure functionally related to the monarchy. It makes these changes for 2010 only, with permanent changes deferred to a future revision of the Comptabiliteitswet.
32123-I.j: The memorandum justifies the temporary deviation from articles 1 and 8 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 by the need to formally enable separate budget statutes for 2010 pending a future modernisation of that law.
q: To make that formally possible, it is necessary to be able to deviate from articles 1 and 8 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
Om die ook formeel mogelijk te maken dient afgeweken te kunnen worden van de artikelen 1 en 8 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

32123-XVIII.s: This bill (Wet) establishes the 2010 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (Wonen, Wijken en Integratie), including the baten-lastendienst Rijksgebouwendienst and Huurcommissie, expressed in thousands of euros. Article 4 provides a temporary exception to the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for this budget, allowing the explanatory notes to present the required per-policy-article information in a different place, as part of a departmental experiment in political accountability.
32123-XVIII.j: The memorandum justifies the article 4 deviation as necessary for an experiment to improve political accountability, to be evaluated in 2010.
q: For the experiment it is necessary in those years to deviate from several provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the departmental budget and annual report.

Ten behoeve van het experiment is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van de departementale begroting en het departementale jaarverslag.

32222-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget schedules (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration, including the Rijksgebouwendienst operating-cost schedule, in connection with the Autumn Budget Review (Najaarsnota), raising the total budget by a net amount in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 December of the budget year with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the 2009 budget schedules of the Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration budget (change connected with the Autumn Budget Review)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaten van de begroting Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2009 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

32360-F.s: This bill is a supplementary budget law (slotwet) that adjusts the 2009 budget of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds), raising the expenditure for animal disease control from 10,998 to 18,773 thousand euro, and enacts the 2009 final accounts. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The 2009 budget of the Animal Health Fund is amended, as shown in the budget schedule attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32609-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget of the Youth and Family ministry (XVII) through an incidental supplementary budget, mainly transferring its budget items to the ministries of Health, Welfare and Sport, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs. It also exempts the ministry from preparing an annual report and closing balance for 2011 and assigns budget management to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport in agreement with two other ministers.
32609-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the exemption from the annual report and closing balance by the one-off nature of the transfer and notes that the Audit services and the Court of Audit can verify the transfer of balance items.
q: Deviating from article 51, second paragraph, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, no annual report and no closing balance are prepared by the relevant Minister for the Youth and Family budget for 2011.

In afwijking van artikel 51, tweede lid, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 wordt met betrekking tot de begroting van Jeugd en Gezin over het jaar 2011 door Onze betrokken Minister geen jaarverslag en geen saldibalans opgemaakt.
d: budget management of Youth and Family for 2011
p: Departs from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 by exempting the ministry from preparing an annual report and closing balance for 2011, reducing accountability information for parliament, though the Audit services and Court of Audit can still check the transfers.

32710-G.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, the VAT compensation fund, by adjusting its expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. It is a supplementary budget and closing budget law (Slotwet) that sets the realised outcome for 2010 and takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: So it is that We, in joint consultation with the States General, have deemed fit and resolved
Zo is het, dat Wij, met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

33240-H.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement of the BES-fonds (Caribbean Netherlands fund) by adjusting appropriations and fixing the 2011 free allocation at 24.9 million euro. It also sets the entry-into-force date of the supplementary budget law.
q: The commitment amount referred to in article 88 of the Public Finance Act of Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba for the free allocation is set at 24.9 million euro for the 2011 allocation year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 88 van de Wet financiën openbare lichamen Bonaire Sint Eustatius en Saba ter zake van de vrije uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2011 vastgesteld op € 24,9 miljoen.

33400-J.s: The bill formally adopts the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting expenditure and revenue at €972.6 million and specifying allocations across flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and experimentation. It also sets the entry-into-force date and states that the budget is stated in thousands of euros.
33400-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation article by stating it allows Deltafonds spending on other policy areas if linked to water safety or freshwater measures and backed by additional funding from other budgets or third parties.
q: The condition is that these measures are connected to measures for water safety or freshwater supply and that there is additional financing from other Rijk budgets or third parties.
Voorwaarde is wel dat deze maatregelen samenhangen met maatregelen ten behoeve van waterveiligheid of zoetwatervoorziening en dat er sprake is van additionele financiering

33480-B.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants. It enters into force on 1 December 2012 or retroactively if published later.
q: The budget of expenditure and revenue of the municipal fund for the year 2012 is amended, as shown in the budget statement attached to this law.
De begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2012 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat.

33605-C.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the provinciefonds, the fund that finances the provinces, by setting final commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants and recording the realised figures. It also sets the rounding convention and entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This concerns a difference of minus € 320,000.
Het gaat hierbij om een verschil van – € 320.000 (negatief).

33750-B.s: This bill fixes the 2014 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at a total of about EUR 18.38 billion, in thousands of euros, and sets the 2014 commitment amounts under the Financiële-verhoudingswet for general, supplementary, integration and decentralisation grants. The accompanying explanatory memorandum is a budget-technical summary covering fund items, reductions under the Rutte II coalition agreement, and the decentralisation of permit, supervision and enforcement tasks to municipalities.
q: The commitment amount in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for grant year 2014 at EUR 15,663,259,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2014 vastgesteld op € 15.663.259.000.

33805-A.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund by adjusting commitments, expenditures and revenues across transport infrastructure items, effective from 1 December 2013. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
33805-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by claims for compensation (nadeelcompensatie) expected from the Raad van State's rulings, with no new executive powers claimed.
q: This amount is strongly dependent on the ruling of the Council of State.
Dit bedrag is sterk afhankelijk van de uitspraak van de Raad van State.

33930-B.s: This slotwet (final budget adjustment act) amends the 2013 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the final commitment amounts and budget figures for the year. It is a technical budget reconciliation with no new executive powers.
33930-B.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget difference by noting that payments to municipalities may diverge from the budget until the distribution factor is final, due to differences between estimated and applied allocation criteria.
q: as long as the distribution factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities may deviate from what is stated in the budget
zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat

33940-A.s: The bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for 2014 (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway, mega-project and other items. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and fixes the entry-into-force date, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2014 if the Staatsblad appears later.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2014
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2014

34085-XVII.s: The bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) through a supplementary budget adopted alongside the autumn memorandum, adjusting commitments and expenditure across policy articles. It sets the amended figures in thousands of euros and provides that the law takes effect on 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
34085-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as required by the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, which require explanation of significant differences between original and current estimates.
q: In accordance with the Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften and the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, notable differences between the original and current estimates must be explained.
Conform de Rijksbegrotingsvoorschriften en de Comptabiliteitswet van 2001 dienen de opmerkelijke verschillen tussen de oorspronkelijke en huidige raming te worden toegelicht.

34210-J.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds for 2015 (first supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across budget articles such as flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance and water quality. It also reallocates and lowers funding for experimentation projects under article III of the Deltawet, with the change taking effect from 1 June 2015.
34210-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for a supplementary budget and by reallocations such as the 2014 financing of the Marker Wadden project, without invoking delegated powers.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment to the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2015.
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2015

34300-J.s: The bill sets the 2016 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds for water safety and freshwater supply, with expenditure and revenue of about €1.211 billion. The explanatory memorandum covers budget articles and an experimental article allowing Deltafonds spending on other policy areas if additional funding is provided.
34300-J.j: The memorandum justifies the experimental article as serving integrated implementation of the Delta Programme and allowing integrated financing.
q: The condition is that these measures are connected to measures for water safety or freshwater supply and that there is additional financing from other budgets or third parties.
Voorwaarde is wel dat deze maatregelen samenhangen met maatregelen ten behoeve van waterveiligheid of zoetwatervoorziening en dat er sprake is van additionele financiering
d: experimental spending on other policy areas from the Deltafonds

34550-C.s: The bill formally sets the 2017 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), fixing commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force on 1 January 2017, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2017 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2017 wordt vastgesteld.

34730-C.s: The bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the provincial fund (provinciefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants and raising the fund's total to about 2.285 billion euro. It takes effect on 1 June 2017, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provincial fund for the year 2017
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2017

35200-J.s: This bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) through a closing budget law (Slotwet), adjusting spending and revenue figures across articles on water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experiments and water quality. It is a technical accounting adjustment that does not delegate rule-making power or shift power away from parliament or the courts.
q: Whereas We have considered that a change to the budget statement of the Delta Fund for the year 2018 has proved necessary
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds, voor het jaar 2018

35210-I.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), adding 909 thousand euros in commitments and expenditure, mainly for functional expenditure on article 2 (721 thousand) and cross-charged expenditure (188 thousand), with 166 thousand in receipts. The amendment takes effect from 1 June 2019 and is made by the Crown together with the States General.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Royal Household's budget for the year 2019
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2019

35300-I.s: This bill sets the 2020 budget for the Crown (Begroting I), fixing expenditure at EUR 44.362 million with no revenue, in thousands of euros. It also states that the budget takes effect on 1 January 2020, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 9 September 2019 that it has no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and recommends submitting them to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport of 16 September 2019 notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

35450-C.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting new commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants and raising total commitments by about 44.4 million euros. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 May 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2020

35470-A.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Slotwet), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project articles following the first and second supplementary budgets. It makes only technical, accounting and audit-driven corrections and contains no delegation of rule-making power or shift of authority to the executive.
35470-A.j: The explanatory memorandum says the bill includes only technical implementation changes, accounting changes and changes arising from audit findings, and that earlier changes were shared with parliament by letter.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, accounting changes, or changes arising from audit findings;
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen;

35570-XVII.s: This bill adopts the 2021 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes development priorities such as education, governance and the rule of law, with no delegation of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2021 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2021 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2021 budget bill for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) and found no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport confirms the advice is accepted and notes a separate non-blank opinion on the Ministry of Finance budget, with some budget amendments.

35650-A.s: This bill amends the departmental expenditure budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructure Fund for 2020 through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and megaproject line items. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively from 1 December 2020.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2020
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2020

35830-A.s: The bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Slotwet) by adjusting appropriations and receipts across transport infrastructure articles, based on the 1st and 2nd supplementary budgets and final realisations. It is a purely technical bookkeeping adjustment that takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December 2020.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, changes of an accounting nature, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

35975-XIV.s: The bill amends the 2021 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, the NVWA agency budget, and the Animal Health Fund for the second supplementary budget, with retroactive effect from 1 December 2021. It is a budgetary appropriation law that changes spending and commitment amounts and does not itself delegate rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (XIV) for the year 2021 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (XIV) voor het jaar 2021 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35975-XVI.s: This second supplementary budget bill amends the 2021 departmental budget of the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport, along with the agency and budget fund budgets for that year. The accompanying memorandum explains budget shifts for the NVWA, RIVM, ZonMW, training and labour market programmes, and corona-related care costs.
35975-XVI.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by pointing to additional tasks for the NVWA and RIVM, the coronavirus pandemic causing delays, and budget reallocations between ministries.
q: The budget has been increased by € 6.3 million for additional assignments given to the RIVM.
Het budget is verhoogd met € 6,3 miljoen voor additionele opdrachten die aan het RIVM zijn verstrekt.

36100-J.s: This bill amends the 2021 budget statement (slotwet) of the Deltafonds, adjusting budgets for water safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experiments, and water quality to match realised spending. The memorandum explains that only technical execution, bookkeeping and audit-driven adjustments are included, and that the amendments are shown per budget line.
36100-J.j: The memorandum justifies the adjustments as technical execution, bookkeeping or control-finding mutations rather than new powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen.

36200-I.s: This bill sets the 2023 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) for the King's household, in thousands of euros, covering constitutional allowances to royal family members, functional expenditure of the King, and charged expenditure from other budgets. The explanatory memorandum describes the allocation and the audit and review arrangements, including external accountant certification and review by the Auditdienst Rijk and the Algemene Rekenkamer.
36200-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget allocations by reference to the Wet financieel statuut van het Koninklijk Huis and the constitutional allowance rules, and describes existing controls rather than new powers.
q: Every year this is checked by an accountant, with a review by the Auditdienst Rijk and the Algemene Rekenkamer.
Ieder jaar vindt hierop controle plaats door een accountant met daarop een review door de Auditdienst Rijk en de Algemene Rekenkamer.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering reviewed the 2023 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and had no remarks, advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets need changes and refers to attached amendments.

36350-C.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) by raising the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants, with effect from 1 June 2023. It sets the new amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2023

36360-B.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), the final budget adjustment (slotwet), and sets the commitment amounts for general, integration and decentralisation grants for 2022. It also states the law enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2022 grant year at € 34,126,138,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2022 vastgesteld op € 34.126.138.000.

36470-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2023 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2023.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment to the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2023
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking voor het jaar 2023

36550-A.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Mobiliteitsfonds (Mobility Fund) through a first supplementary budget, shifting commitments and expenditure across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project items, with retroactive effect from 1 June 2024. The explanatory memorandum records budget shifts for the Schoon Emissieloos Bouwen programme and the A12/A15 project, with no new executive discretion or delegation of rule-making.
q: The budget statement of the Mobiliteitsfonds (A) for the year 2024 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds (A) voor het jaar 2024 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36560-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue across five policy articles to reflect supplementary budgets and the final realisation. It is a technical budget adjustment (Slotwet) that formally fixes the 2023 accounts in euros.
q: Amendment of the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2023 (Final Budget Act)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2023 (Slotwet)

36613-A.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the Mobiliteitsfonds (A) through a supplementary budget, shifting commitment and expenditure amounts among infrastructure articles and retroactively effective from 17 September 2024. It also contains the statement of changes and an explanatory memorandum noting extra funding for rail signalling projects after ProRail failed to certify the old signals as safe.
36613-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget increase by the need to keep rail signalling projects from stalling after the old signals were not declared safe.
q: To keep the implementation of the projects in realisation from stalling, the commitment budget is increased by € 31.4 million and transferred to PHS.
Om de uitvoering van de projecten in realisatie niet stil te laten vallen wordt het verplichtingenbudget opgehoogd met € 31,4 miljoen en overgeheveld naar PHS.

36740-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (Slotwet), adjusting appropriations and expenditures across five policy articles to reflect supplementary budgets and realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The need has become apparent for an amendment of the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2024.
De noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking voor het jaar 2024.

36800-C.s: The bill fixes the 2026 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) at €3.696 billion, setting the commitment amounts for the general grant (€3.437 billion) and decentralisation grants (€259 million). It also sets the entry-into-force rule and notes that the explanatory memorandum concerns converting specific grants into fund grants to increase subnational autonomy.
36800-C.j: The memorandum justifies the grant conversions as increasing autonomy of subnational governments and reducing administrative and control burdens.
q: to increase the autonomy of subnational governments and reduce administrative and control burdens
om autonomie van medeoverheden te vergroten en administratieve- en controlelasten te verminderen

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State has no remarks on the draft 2026 budget statute for the provinciefonds and advises submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's reply (nader rapport) confirms the blanco advice and reports technical adjustments raising the 2026 total from EUR 3,539,424,000 to EUR 3,696,842,000 to reflect updated accres figures and BCF ceiling space.

36820-A.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds A) through a series of budget adjustments across infrastructure items such as road, rail and waterway networks. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective retroactively from 16 September 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (A) for the year 2025
